notes.title: Yokai Art 2 Demo 2.0 Released – New Maps, Bosses, and More!
notes.content:
[h2]Demo 2.0 Released – New Maps, Bosses, and More![/h2]

Hello Yokai Art players!   

We’re back with a major content drop that expands the world, deepens the challenges, and sets the stage for epic battles ahead. Here's what’s new:[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572920/c758d2051055953905311a0926e71635807f1ecc.jpg"][/img][/p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3405160/Yokai_Art_2_Tales_of_the_NineTails/"][/dynamiclink][hr][/hr][h2]🗺️ New Maps & Levels[/h2][p]Explore brand-new regions with unique gameplay mechanics:[/p][list][*][p][b]Jiangnan Map[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Levels:[/i] 2-1, 2-2, 2-3[/p][/*][*][p][i]Features:[/i] Navigate the new [b]Water Lane[/b], complete with aquatic enemies and dynamic boat mechanics![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572920/7492981433bdaee26c7201be3f242a3b16481b80.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Television Studio Map[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Levels:[/i] 2-4, 2-5[/p][/*][*][p][i]Features:[/i] Engage in tactical rescue operations with [b]toggle-able mechanic tiles[/b] to [b]save Cameraman hostages[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572920/85926d42743ba8ddc16b3a006e8665da22d7e284.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🎚️ New Map Features[/h2][p]We've added exciting new features to make each run more dynamic and replayable:[/p][list][*][p][b]Difficulty Mode Selector[/b] – Choose your challenge: [i]Chill[/i], [i]Normal[/i], or [i]Hard[/i].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Jiangnan Enhancements[/b] – Strategic water combat and terrain navigation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]TV Studio Twists[/b] – Puzzle-like scenarios and interactive mission objectives.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]👊 New Bosses[/h2][p]Two formidable foes have entered the battlefield:[/p][list][*][p][b]Mouse Thug Boss[/b] 
A streetwise troublemaker who specializes in lobbing [b]multiple firecrackers[/b] to [b]blind and disorient[/b] your units. His unpredictable attacks and area control make positioning critical in this fast-paced encounter.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572920/6819731cd14b00e69fd500a8cebeae90a6bc9071.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Hone Onna Boss[/b]
A haunting [b]bone yokai[/b] who takes the form of an eerie [b]singing diva[/b]. Her voice [b]empowers nearby enemies with speed buffs[/b] and culminates in devastating [b]large-area damage[/b], turning the battlefield into a deadly stage.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572920/6a7bab47947c0f7875301fc654e4c486ec968c75.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🐢 New Unit: Puppet Turtle[/h2][list][*][p][b]Role:[/b] Artillery Unit[/p][/*][*][p]An [b]RNG-based Artillerist[/b] that launches [b]indirect elemental projectiles[/b] with a small chance to [b]massively crit[/b]. Best deployed in the [b]backline[/b] to apply [b]unpredictable pressure[/b] through varied elemental damage.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572920/b183fdf11f73d05db3d508cab0980663cc5c5483.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🎮 Controller Support (Beta)[/h2][p]Now playable with:[/p][list][*][p][b]Xbox controller[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]PS controller[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Deck[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Enjoy the full experience from the comfort of your controller setup! Feedback welcome as we polish this feature.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🌩️ Sneak Peek: Upcoming Content[/h2][p]Here’s what’s coming soon:[/p][list][*][p][b]Map 3 Expansion[/b][/p][list][*][p]Encounter the [b]Embroidered Uniform Guard Organization[/b] during a stormy, thunderous confrontation.[/p][/*][*][p]Delve into the [b]National Museum[/b] where [b]possessed relics[/b] await your resistance.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Rogue Lite Mode Enhancements[/b][/p][list][*][p]More [b]boons and relics[/b] to diversify your build paths.[/p][/*][*][p]Unlockable [b]God Powers[/b] to shift the tide of battle.[/p][/*][*][p]New bosses and even tougher [b]difficulty tiers[/b]![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]More surprises are in development – stay tuned![/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for your continued support. Whether you’re a strategist, explorer, or speedrunner – there’s something new for everyone.
See you in the next battle! 🐉[/p][p]
Don’t forget to add our upcoming titles to your wishlist for the latest updates and earliest access upon release![/p][p]

notes.title: Yokai Art 2 Demo Now Live — New milestone reached!
notes.content:
[p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/kvgOeJl.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you all, Yokai Art 1 players, for your support! We have successfully released the Yokai Art 2 Demo, marking a small but meaningful step forward for this game IP. Let's step into a mystical strategy game together where folklore meets roguelite chaos and tactical tower defense unfolds the hidden story.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3405170/Yokai_Art_2_Tales_of_the_NineTails_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]What’s Inside the Demo?[/h2][p]Two powerful modes await you in this early slice of the game:[/p][h3]Story Mode (Map 1-1 to Map 1-5)[/h3][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/HZsFRXh.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Engage in 5 unique stages across beautiful environments.[/p][/*][*][p]Dive into comic-style cutscenes and unlock the lore behind the Tales of the Nine-Tails.[/p][/*][*][p]Experience both [b]classic tower defense battles[/b] and the unique [b]merge-style card battle system[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Earn early [b]in-game rewards[/b] that showcase what's to come.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Roguelite Mode[/h3][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/BFobHju.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Test your power in [b]3 difficulty levels[/b], each with escalating threats and blessings.[/p][/*][*][p]Channel divine powers from 4 featured gods:[/p][list][*][p]⚡ [b]Erlang Sheng[/b] (Lightning)[/p][/*][*][p]🔥 [b]Nezha[/b] (Fire)[/p][/*][*][p]🌊 [b]Dragon God[/b] (Water)[/p][/*][*][p]⛰️ [b]Local Earth God[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Mix and match [b]20+ God’s Boons[/b] to break the limit.[/p][/*][*][p]Discover [b]12 powerful relics[/b] to boost your run.[/p][/*][*][p]Choose from [b]2 Player Skills[/b] to shape your battle tactics.[/p][/*][*][p]Progress through a [b]Permanent Upgrade Tree[/b] — carry forward spiritual strength and unlock permanent improvements that grow stronger with every run.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]What to Expect in the Full Release[/h2][p]Your support makes everything below possible. Here’s what’s in store for the final launch:[/p][h3]Full Story Mode[/h3][list][*][p]Play through [b]Map 1-1 to 7-3[/b], completing the full campaign.[/p][/*][*][p]Unlock every [b]story unit[/b], each with unique skills and synergies.[/p][/*][*][p]More girls compared to demo version.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/i5UlMlc.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Dive deeper into the world with [b]full chapter comics and lore[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Access [b]all player skills[/b], including powerful new abilities.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Full Roguelite Mode[/h3][list][*][p]Wield divine powers from [b]12 total gods with many more boons[/b], each adding unique playstyles and interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]Unlock the [b]God Power mechanic[/b]: harness overwhelming power by stacking blessings from a single god.[/p][/*][*][p]Collect the [b]complete relic set[/b] and uncover meta-changing artifacts.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/58lQyJM.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Fully unlock the [b]Permanent Upgrade Tree[/b]: build branching paths that enhance your stats, offer new options, and adapt to your playstyle long-term.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Extras & Replayability[/h3][list][*][p]Unlock exclusive [b]gallery entries and rewards[/b] as you progress.[/p][/*][*][p]Equip [b]character skins[/b] for visual customization.[/p][/*][*][p]Participate in [b]seasonal events[/b] with rotating gameplay twists.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Accessibility[/h3][list][*][p]Controller support[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Wishlist Milestones — Help Unlock Global Rewards![/h2][p]Every wishlist boosts our visibility and unlocks content for all players at launch:[/p][p][b]Wishlist Goal
[/b]5,000 wishlist[/p][list][*][p]+ 1 new non-evolve unit[/p][/*][/list][p]10,000 wishlist[/p][list][*][p]+Animated scene of Summer skin Sanbi for Yokai Art 1 player. (Available when purchased both games)[/p][/*][*][p]10% launch discount[/p][/*][/list][p]20,000 wishlist[/p][list][*][p]+ 1 Unit skin with animated scenes.[/p][/*][*][p]15% launch discount[/p][/*][/list][p]30,000 wishlist[/p][list][*][p]+ 1 Unit skin with animated scenes.[/p][/*][*][p]20% launch discount[/p][/*][/list][p]40,000 wishlist[/p][list][*][p]Nine-tails skin with animated scenes.[/p][/*][*][p]25% launch discount[/p][/*][/list][p]50,000+ wishlist[/p][list][*][p]+ 1 new evolve unit girl with full storyline and animated scene. Yokai type decided by player.[/p][/*][/list][p]And yet more to come[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]📣 How You Can Help[/h2][p]✨ [b]Play the Demo[/b] – Your feedback helps shape the final game. [/p][p]✨ [b]Wishlist & Follow[/b] – Stay up-to-date and help unlock global rewards. [/p][p]✨ [b]Tell Your Friends[/b] – Share the masquerade and spread the spirit! [/p][p]✨ [b]Leave Feedback[/b] – We’d love to hear what you love and what you'd like to see improved.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for joining us on this mythic journey.[/p][p]The yokai await your command...[/p][p]With spirit and steel, [/p][p][b]— Secret Labo —[/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Upcoming Games[/b][/h2][h2][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3189470/OG_Streamer_Beats/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3190420/Eternal_Lust_Zenyh_City/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2494660/Love_Tavern_2_Beastmen_Kingdoms/"][/dynamiclink][/h2]

notes.title: 🎃 Event: The Crimson Witch's Midnight Masquerade 🎃
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UxKrZlA.gif[/img]

The veil between worlds is thinning, and the midnight hour approaches once more. This year, Yokai Art brings you an all-new Halloween event: The Crimson Witch's Midnight Masquerade!

Prepare yourself for an eerie and thrilling journey through 5 new special levels, but beware—entry to these haunting grounds is only for those who have completed last year's terrifying event, The Party of the Crimson Witch. Face off against the [b]Zombie Samurai General[/b] and discover [b]Emily's deadly new moveset![/b]

[h1]💀 New Event Features 💀[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Nm2x0F4.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b] Special Samurai Zombies: [/b]Defeating them is only half the battle! After they fall, they turn into graves—but watch out, these restless spirits will rise again!
[*] [b]Collect Spectre Skulls: [/b]Harvest these rare items to unlock powerful rewards, including the all-new Emily unit and two new player skills to enhance your combat prowess.
[/list]

[h1]🎁 Rewards 🎁[/h1]

[h3][b]New Unit: Emily[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ViG2Xsl.gif[/img]

[u]Description:[/u] Emily can attack multiple rows. Her Talent marks targets with normal attacks. Upon the marked target's death, a skull is triggered, damaging nearby enemies. Talent activation is limited to 15 charges.

[h3][b]2 New Hiro's skills[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TIy12ch.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Cursed Pumpkins[/b]
Summon up to 2 Pumpkin Walls in the selected area to block enemies. After a short time, the pumpkins transform into Skulls that move to the right, damaging all enemies they pass through.
[*] [b]Zombie Samurai[/b]
Summon a random variant of a Zombie Samurai to attack enemies while continuously moving to the right.
[/list]

Don’t miss your chance to participate in this exclusive Halloween event! Unveil the dark secrets of the Crimson Witch and conquer the undead army. Will you rise to the challenge?

Join the [b]Masquerade [/b]now and show the world your might!

Good luck, warriors. The midnight hour awaits!

[b]Entry requirement:[/b] Completion of last year's event, "The Party of the Crimson Witch."

[b]Get Ready:[/b] Now's the best time to explore Yokai Art with our latest update and special Fest deal. See you in the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20335/Secret_Collab_Bundle/

notes.title: Development Update - November 2022
notes.content:
[h1]1. New Feature: Hard Mode for Yokai Art[/h1]

Since most of the players had completely Normal mode, this is additional content for those who want to play more and spend time in Yokai Art. We are working on balancing the Hard Mode right now.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/X1yF6rZ.gif[/img]

[h1]2. New Feature: Formation[/h1]

As mentioned in the previous updates, since we are raising the difficulty of the game, we also want to make some additional mechanics to the gameplay (which might strongly affect the current gameplay) to let you guys have more ways of beating Yokai Art. 

Currently, we have 6 types of formation which are

[list]
[*] 3 formations that required 1 type of element to activate - Consider Normal Tier
[*] 3 formations that required 2 type elements to activate - Consider High Tier
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aqF475O.png[/img]

Formation unique ability: Once you unlock formation at a certain level, an additional passive ability will be added and of course, will benefit players.

Auto-populate formation: The player can preset formation and use it directly in the battle. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TxCBgTV.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FidnBVw.gif[/img]

[h1]3. New Feature: Additional Raijin and Fujin Unit[/h1]

We decided to push up Raijin and Fujin as units that will work differently compared with others. Raijin and Fujin will have high scaling on DPS or Special ability but can only maintain in the battle for a period of time or waves. Thus, it will limit their overpower ability of them. Also, pricing will be higher as well. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Rik6N6J.gif[/img]

[h1]4. Balancing: Normal Difficulty and Strategy[/h1]

As per players' feedback, our gameplay currently somehow still required players to spam units as the strategy. We are still working on it making the game more strategy-oriented, and reducing boss skill damage to prevent 1 hit killing. Hope this will help new players as well as everyone who loves Yokai Art

[h1]5. Controller Support:[/h1]

We are still looking into this for future plan
